relationships.subject: GT1b
relationships.evidence_quote: GT1b stimulation upregulated IL-1β and TNF-α transcripts 17- and 6-fold, respectively

relationships.subject: GT1b
relationships.evidence_quote: Upregulation of proinflammatory cytokines (IL-1β and TNF-α) and Nox2 was observed in GT1b-injected mice, but not in CSF-1-injected mice.

relationships.subject: CSF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: CSF-1 treatment significantly increased Ki67-positive proliferating microglia, and the microglia cell number increased 3-fold

relationships.subject: GT1b
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant decrease in mechanical threshold was observed in GT1b- and CSF-1-injected male mice 1 day post-injection, which lasted up to 7 days

key_findings: GT1b drives proinflammatory gene induction (IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, Nox2) in microglia without proliferation, whereas CSF-1 drives proliferation
Both induced mechanical hypersensitivity in male but not female mice despite microglial proliferation in both sexes
